title: qr-graph observe line
description: One page and one embedded child, as the semantic log recorded them (`depends_on`, `dependency_skipped`) and as the code declares them.

page.description: The parent URI as logged, without query.

child.description: The child URI as logged, without query.

observed.description: What the sessions recorded for this pair: `depends_on`, or the `reason` of a `dependency_skipped` (`no_body`, `no_etag_or_surrogate_key`), or a bare `dependency_skipped` from a log that records no reason. Empty for an `unclassified` child.

declared.description: How the page's onGet declares the child: `donut` when the page's class declares #[CacheableResponse] or #[DonutCache], `embedded` otherwise, null when neither an `#[Embed]` of the page nor its layout names the child.

verdict.description: `material`, `hole` and `dependency` are the expected shapes. `untagged-material`: the page reads the child but the child carried no ETag or Surrogate-Key, so a change to the child's data does not reach the page's template through this child; the page may still carry the tags itself, which only its own save_etag/save_donut tags tell. `unclassified`: the page was written (`put_donut`) but the declared child was no longer an embedded request at the top of its body (removed with `unset()`, replaced by its body array, or moved into a nested array), so it adds no tag to the page even when the page read it. `skipped`: a child skipped without a logged reason, so a hole and an untagged child cannot be told apart. `undeclared`: no declaration to compare with. `mixed`: the sessions disagree.
